raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "give discount"
  role subject "Solaris Data"
  role object "20%"
  role condition "sign for 2 years"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  speaker "Joana"

@s2 stated
  relation "start after"
  role subject "the discount"
  role object "the first year"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  speaker "Miguel"

@q query
  select ?p
  where match
    relation "reach price"
    role object ?p
    role time "the first year"
    role condition "list price 48000 EUR"
    polarity affirmed
  end
